defs.def: able to make sensible decisions and give good advice because of the experience and knowledge that you have 人

ex.s: Turner wisely said that “doing well” psychologically is being able to roll with the flow of emotions, manage them, communicate clearly and well with others, and master various skills.
ex.t: 特纳明智地说，“从心理上讲”“做得好”是能够顺应情绪的流动，管理情绪，与他人清晰良好地沟通，并掌握各种技能。“

ex.s: Here are some tips on making wise decisions to minimize pressure on the places we visit and improve our experience.
ex.t: 以下是一些建议，帮助你做出明智的决定，减轻我们游览之地的压力，并提升我们的体验。

ex.s: Still, looking back on the photos, they are some of my best shots though they could have been so much better if I would have been prepared and managed my time wisely.
ex.t: 尽管如此，回头看这些照片，它们仍是我最好的作品之一，不过如果我准备充分、合理安排时间，它们本可以好得多。

ex.s: Native Americans had taken care of these precious natural resources wisely.
ex.t: 美洲原住民一直明智地照料着这些珍贵的自然资源。

ex.s: The wise old man told him to travel to the Li River～perhaps he could learn a little from the greatest artist in the world.
ex.t: 那位睿智的老人让他去漓江旅行——也许他能从业界最伟大的画家那里学到一点东西。

ex.s: The implication of these results is that to gain the greatest health benefits from exercise, it may be wise to skip eating first.
ex.t: 多个基因的表现因是否在步行前进食而不同。

ex.s: decide wisely what to eatD. eat whatever is offered
ex.t: 明智地决定吃什么 D. 吃提供的任何食物

ex.s: B．A wise man can live without self﹣pity．
ex.t: B．智者能不带自怜地生活。

ex.s: For those who have no access to courses, help might be at hand thanks to Jerry Witkovsky and his method of using four jars to teach teenagers how to spend their money wisely.
ex.t: 对于那些无法参加课程的人，杰里·维特科夫斯基和他的方法或许能帮上忙——他用四个罐子教青少年如何明智地花钱。

ex.s: Given the degree of doubt, Mr Stienwand suggests, “it would be wise to stop cloud seeding.” In practice, doubt has had the opposite effect.
ex.t: 鉴于怀疑的程度，斯坦万德先生建议：“停止人工降雨是明智的。”但在实践中，怀疑产生了相反的效果。

defs.def: sensible; based on good judgement 行动和行为

ex.s: He(s also known as a wise and witty populariser of Chinese philosophy and the Chinese way of life.
ex.t: 他也以一位智慧风趣的中国哲学和中国生活方式普及者而闻名。

defs.def: to not understand sth, even after it has been explained to you （解释之后）依然不懂，仍不明白

ex.s: “But girls should also be wise to take up challenges when needed.
ex.t: “但女孩也应该明智地在需要时接受挑战。

defs.def: to not know or find out about sth bad that sb has done 不知道，发现不了（某人做的坏事）

ex.s: It is encouraging to discover that by readily accepting our errors and wisely placing ourselves in the way of being wrong, we can in fact overcome weaknesses and rise stronger.
ex.t: 令人鼓舞的是，我们发现，通过欣然接受错误、明智地让自己处于可能犯错的位置，我们事实上能克服弱点、变得更强。

ex.s: He always knows how to make wise decisions.
ex.t: 他总是知道如何做出明智的决定。

ex.s: Whenever you make a choice, your character is reinforced, or changes, or grows, or diminishes, depending on whether the decision you made is wise or foolish, good or bad.
ex.t: 每当你做出选择时，你的品格就会得到加强、改变、成长或削弱，这取决于你做的决定是明智还是愚蠢，是好还是坏。
